title: Prerequisites and Learning Resources knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Prerequisites and Learning Resources?
options: It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
one utility expresses one CSS concern or a closely related behavior
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
questions.answer_key: one utility expresses one CSS concern or a closely related behavior
questions.explanation: Prerequisites and Learning Resources is best understood through the syllabus topics: HTML fundamentals, CSS fundamentals, Basic responsive design. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with prerequisites and learning resources?
options: combine meaningful utilities in markup and verify browser styles
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
questions.answer_key: combine meaningful utilities in markup and verify browser styles
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: HTML fundamentals, CSS fundamentals, Basic responsive design, Command-line and package-manager basics.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying prerequisites and learning resources?
options: Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
visual styling does not replace semantic HTML or actual interactive behavior
questions.answer_key: visual styling does not replace semantic HTML or actual interactive behavior
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
